title: ReLaDrift: Recurrent Language Generation via Drifting for Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.23225v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Drifting Models generate a sample with a single function evaluation, making them attractive for fast parallel language generation, but their one-step formulation does not support iterative refinement. We propose Recurrent Language Generation via Drifting (ReLaDrift), which uses a shared Drifting Model to generate an initial draft from noise and iteratively refine it in a continuous latent space. We train this recurrence by sampling the number of rounds and applying the drifting loss only at the final round, stopping gradients through preceding rounds so that only one round requires backpropagation. Unlike the one-step Drifting Model, whose accuracy does not improve when iterated, ReLaDrift enables a trade-off between test-time computation and generation quality, as diffusion and flow language models do. translated_title: ReLaDrift：基于漂移的循环语言生成用于测试时扩展
translated_abstract: 漂移模型只需一次函数求值即可生成一个样本，这使其在快速并行语言生成方面极具吸引力，但其单步形式不支持迭代细化。我们提出基于漂移的循环语言生成，它使用一个共享的漂移模型从噪声生成初始草稿，并在连续潜在空间中对其进行迭代细化。我们通过随机采样循环轮数、且仅在最后一轮应用漂移损失来训练这种循环机制，同时阻断穿过前几轮的梯度，使得每一步只需对一轮进行反向传播。与单步漂移模型不同（后者即使迭代也不会提升准确率），ReLaDrift 能够像扩散语言模型和流语言模型那样，在测试时计算量与生成质量之间进行权衡。在 Sudoku Hard 和 GSM8K 上，它相较于这些迭代生成方法取得了具有竞争力或更优的性能。
tldr: 提出ReLaDrift，利用共享漂移模型在连续潜在空间中对生成结果进行循环迭代细化，首次使单步漂移模型具备测试时计算量与生成质量之间的可调节权衡能力。
en_tdlr: ReLaDrift enables a one-step Drifting Model to iteratively refine its output in a continuous latent space through recurrence, achieving a test-time compute-versus-quality trade-off comparable to diffusion and flow language models.
